mobile.computers.own_tunnel.insecure_off.v1: 使用http://时，中继密码会以明文在网络中传输，因此默认关闭，需你手动开启。只要地址支持，请始终使用https://。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.insecure_off.v2: 使用http://时，中继密码会以明文在网络中传输，因此除非你手动开启，否则此选项保持关闭。只要地址支持，请始终使用https://。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.insecure_off.english: Over http:// your relay password crosses the network in the clear, so it is off unless you turn it on. Use https:// whenever the address supports it.
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.insecure_off.comment: 除非你手动开启，否则此选项保持关闭 correctly says "off unless you turn it on", and 此选项 correctly points to the opt-in. http:// and https:// are unchanged, with counts 1/1.

mobile.computers.own_tunnel.private_host.v1: 此地址位于你自己的网络内，因此风险仅限于该网络。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.private_host.v2: 此地址位于你自己的网络内，因此暴露范围仅限于该网络。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.private_host.english: This address is on your own network, so the exposure is limited to it.
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.private_host.comment: 暴露范围 translates "exposure" exactly and matches the security body.

mobile.computers.own_tunnel.public_host.v1: 此地址不是私有地址——此手机与它之间的任何一方都能读取密码。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.public_host.v2: 此地址不是私有地址——从此手机到该地址途经的任何网络或设备都能读取密码。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.public_host.english: This address is not a private one — anything between this phone and it can read the password.
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.public_host.comment: Names the networks and devices on the path between the phone and the address (途经的任何网络或设备). The "either party" misreading is gone, the warning stays strong, and the paired dash —— is kept.

mobile.computers.own_tunnel.step_test_he.v1: 在保存任何内容之前，这会先通过你的隧道发送一次真实请求。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.step_test_he.v2: 保存前，会先通过你的隧道发送一次真实请求。
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.step_test_he.english: This makes a real request through your tunnel before anything is saved.
mobile.computers.own_tunnel.step_test_he.comment: The calqued subject is gone. 保存前 is accurate for "before anything is saved", and the subjectless 会先 reads naturally as UI help.

mobile.computers.own_tunnel.security_hea.comment: 暴露 now matches the body (暴露到互联网上) and 公网 matches url_label (公网URL). Leaving out the object 电脑 is fine in a heading, because the body directly below names the computer. No final full stop; 8 CJK characters.
